meta.label: Data Contract Generator
meta.description: Generate JSON data contracts from a Dataiku dataset schema and write them to a project managed folder.
meta.author: Julia Hofmeister

params.description:
Output folder

Configure where generated data contracts are stored. The macro writes to a project managed folder named data_contracts. If the folder does not already exist, it is created on the selected storage connection. An administrator may still need to enable managed folder usage on the selected connection.

params.name: folder_connection_name
params.label: Managed folder storage connection
params.description: Connection used when creating the data_contracts managed folder. Choose a storage or warehouse storage connection. API/LLM connections will not work even if they appear in this selector.

Metadata fields

Choose which optional metadata fields this plugin should write into generated data contracts. Disable a field to omit it from generated JSON.

params.name: include_tag_field
params.label: Include tag field
params.description: When enabled, users can select one or more tags per column and the contract will write a JSON array named tag.

params.name: allow_custom_tag_values
params.label: Allow custom tag values
params.description: When enabled, users can type additional tag values per column in the macro. When disabled, users must choose from the configured tag choices.

params.name: include_classification_field
params.label: Include classification field
params.description: When enabled, users can select one classification per column and the contract will write a JSON string named classification.

params.name: include_category_field
params.label: Include category field
params.description: When enabled, users can select one category per column and the contract will write a JSON string named category.

Metadata choices

Configure the allowed values that appear in the macro for tags, classifications, and categories. Add one value per entry.

params.name: tag_choices
params.label: Tag choices
params.description: Allowed values for the JSON property named tag. Users can select multiple tags for a single column.

params.name: classification_choices
params.label: Classification choices
params.description: Allowed values for the JSON property named classification. Values are organization-specific.

params.name: category_choices
params.label: Category choices
params.description: Allowed values for the JSON property named category. Values are organization-specific.
